high.title: Interest Rates Still High After State Bank of Vietnam's Regulatory Document
high.summary: Despite the State Bank of Vietnam's regulatory intervention, deposit interest rates remain elevated across the banking sector. VIB adjusted its rates down by 0.3-0.4 percentage points on April 2nd, with deposits from 1-5 billion VND now at 7.5%/year and above 5 billion VND at 7.6%/year. However, these rates are still 0.5 percentage points higher than VIB's listed 12-month term deposit rate of 7%/year. Other banks continue offering high rates: Vietbank applies the 4.75%/year ceiling for short-term deposits (1-5 months) as per SBV regulations, but longer-term rates reach 7.5%/year (6 months) and 7.8%/year (12 months). OCB offers up to 7.1%/year for 12-month deposits and 7.7%/year for 36-month terms. The persistence of high deposit rates despite regulatory pressure suggests banks are still competing aggressively for funding, potentially indicating continued liquidity tightness in the system and pressure on net interest margins.

high.title: HDBank Interest Rates Latest April 2026
high.summary: HDBank's deposit interest rates in early April 2026 range from 0.5-8.1%/year for counter deposits. Non-term deposits are at 0.4%/year, while short-term deposits (1 week to under 1 month) offer 0.5%/year. The 1-2 month term carries 3.5%/year, and 3-5 month terms offer 3.6%/year. Longer terms show significant rate increases: 6-month deposits earn 5.4%/year, 7-11 month terms at 5.2%/year. For 12-month deposits, HDBank offers different rates depending on the product type, with standard deposits earning competitive rates. The structured rate schedule reflects banks' continued need for longer-term funding, with meaningful premiums for extended maturities. This rate structure indicates HDBank is actively competing for deposits while managing asset-liability duration matching.

medium.title: SJC Gold and Ring Gold Prices Afternoon April 3
medium.summary: SJC gold prices remained stable in the afternoon session at 171-174.5 million VND/tael, with major dealers maintaining similar levels. Gold ring prices also traded sideways, with SJC at 170.8-174.3 million VND/tael and DOJI at the market high of 171-174.5 million VND/tael. The stability suggests consolidation after morning recovery attempts.

medium.title: SJC Gold and Ring Gold Prices April 2 - Dropped Nearly 4 Million VND/Tael
medium.summary: Gold prices recovered from session lows but remained 3.2-3.4 million VND/tael lower than the previous day. SJC gold closed at 170-173.5 million VND/tael, down 3.7 million VND on the buy side and 3.2 million VND on the sell side. The significant daily decline reflects continued volatility in the domestic gold market.

medium.title: First Securities Company Reveals Q1/2026 Business Results
medium.summary: Vietcap Securities (VCI) reported preliminary Q1/2026 pre-tax profit of around 400 billion VND, up 13% year-on-year. The company set ambitious 2026 targets of 6.525 trillion VND in operating revenue and 2.3 trillion VND in pre-tax profit, representing 30% and 41% growth respectively. The strong start suggests positive momentum for the securities sector.

medium.title: VietBank Stock Preparing to List on HoSE
medium.summary: HoSE has received the listing application for nearly 1.1 billion shares of VietBank (VBB), currently trading on UPCoM at around 11,600 VND/share. The bank has been targeting HoSE listing since 2020 and now meets all regulatory requirements for market capitalization and financial performance standards.

medium.title: A Billionaire's Stock Sold by Foreign Investors for Over 1,000 Billion VND in Week 30/3-3/4
medium.summary: Foreign investors net sold 1.025 trillion VND across the market during the week, with VN-Index closing at 1,684.04 points (+0.67%). VHM faced the heaviest selling pressure from foreign investors, while MSN led net buying with 432 billion VND. The significant foreign outflows indicate continued risk-off sentiment from international investors.
